information_wall.validation_actions: fixed labels for checkpoint-screen loss only
information_wall.writer_input: correct task language plus exactly one action-hidden correct-task teacher video
information_wall.video_action_episode_pairing: different episodes from the same validation task

sampling.action_demo_selection: group-keyed deterministic no-replacement permutation excluding the teacher-video episode
sampling.action_frame_selection: row-keyed deterministic uniform frame from the selected action episode
sampling.policy_noise_schedule: sha256 first 63 bits of canonical JSON [schema,seed,global_task_id,video_group]
sampling.task_aggregation: mean within each task then equal mean across eight tasks

checkpoint_selection.purpose: cheap saturation and candidate screening only
checkpoint_selection.conflict_rule: closed-loop success overrides functional validation loss
